messages:
Maya P: Quick async: compact Q3 OKR handoff for the 'lighthouse' milestone. Please post a single-line status each: shipped | slipped | next step | owner | ETA. I’ll fold into the weekly OKR summary after EOD. Ping if you need help. cc @Alex T @Sam R

Alex T: shipped | runtime-autoscale-v3 canary -> 10% (deploy: https://deploys.internal/runs/1301). owner: Alex T. next step: scale to 50% after perf validation. ETA: 2026-03-19. blockers: none atm.

Sam R: slipped | dedicated scheduler progress slowed by infra refactor and test infra delays. owner: Sam R. next step: cut scope (drop multi-tenant metrics), triage backlog. ETA: ~2w. blockers: infra review + perf harness spinup. @eng-infra can we get a test node boot this week?

Priya M: shipped | per-route dashboard (MVP) merged to main with basic metrics panels. owner: Priya M. next step: wire traces view + small UX polish. ETA: next Tue. blocker: potential overlap with API key rotation work.

Chris B: noted an edge-case where reroute can leak tokens under a very specific retry pattern; created issue #4123 and paused the canary. owner: Chris B. next step: patch + run targeted tests. ETA: tonight. CR pinged @Alex T for expedited review.

Alex T: ack. Holding the 50% push until Chris' patch lands and smoke tests pass. Prepared rollback plan if needed. Rollback command pinned:
```
./deploy rollback runtime-autoscale-v3 --to=canary-0.0.2
```
Will post results here after test run.

Sam R: Proposed reduced-scope plan (short): (1) ship scheduler core MVP without tenant metrics; (2) defer autoscale policy UI; (3) preserve API compatibility. Document: https://docs.internal/scope/scheduler-reduced. No objections noted so far; will proceed unless someone raises a hard blocker.

deploy-bot: Canary paused for runtime-autoscale-v3 in us-west-2 at 2026-03-18T15:14:12Z :warning:

Maya P: Two asks: (1) owners confirm ETA in this thread by EOD; (2) Chris please add mitigation steps + a customer-facing note to #4123 so PMs can prep messaging.

Chris B: Done  added mitigation steps and a short customer note to #4123. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987. CR pinged Alex.

Priya M: Design sign-off on traces integration is green; will require a tiny API tweak (tracked in #4130) but it's not expected to change ETA.

Alex T: Reviewing PR now. If the tests fail I’ll revert the canary and post status here; if green I’ll approve and resume rollout.

Maya P: Thanks all. I’ll stitch these lines into the weekly OKR post. If anyone wants explicit risk language called out in the update, drop a sentence here before EOD. :thumbsup:
